description: Get AIHOT's edited weekly report: the week's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this week or in a given ISO week; omit week for the latest.

lang.description: Answer language: en gives the titles, summaries and digests in English where translated (the few not yet stay in Chinese), links to the English pages and English wording; zh (the default) answers in Chinese.

week.description: Optional real ISO week such as 2026-W39. Omit for the latest weekly report.

name: aihot_get_weekly
